Find Healthcare Providers: Compare Care Near YouFind Medicare-approved providers near you & compare care quality for nursing homes, doctors, hospitals, hospice centers, more. Official Medicare site.

What is Healthcare Provider Tool - Quick, Easy InfoLearn about new Medicare provider search tool that helps you choose Medicare providers & facilities & compare quality ratings. Official Medicare site.

Dialysis Facility Quality Of Patient Care RatingCompare dialysis facility performance with dialysis facility quality of patient care rating. Rated between 1-5 stars. Official Medicare site.

Dialysis Facility Patient Star Rating - 5 Star ScaleLearn about dialysis facility patient star ratings & see how patients rate experience between 1-5 stars. More stars, better quality care. Official Medicare site.

Home Health Agency Quality Of Patient Care Star RatingSee how home health agency quality of patient care star ratings are calculated, based on 8 care measures of process & outcome. Official Medicare site.

Patient Survey Rating For Home Health AgenciesUse patient survey rating for home health agencies to better understand quality of care for home health agencies. Learn more. Official Medicare site.

Star Rating For Hospitals - More Stars, Better CareLearn how star rating for hospitals weighs quality measures like mortality, safety of care, readmission, others into rating. Learn more. Official Medicare site.

Hospital Patient Survey Star Rating - 5 Star ScaleSee side-by-side hospital ratings with patient survey star rating. Based on patient experience coming from HCAHPS survey. Learn more. Official Medicare site.

Patient Survey Scores for Physicians & DoctorsGet info on patient survey scores for physicians to make best choice in doctor & care. Compare & see scores on doctors profile page. Official Medicare site.

Understanding MIPS Quality Performance MeasuresSee how doctor performance scores are calculated using MIPS quality performance measures. Know doctor ratings, get best care. Official Medicare site.

Medicare-Certified 4 Levels of Hospice CareUnderstand 4 levels of Medicare-certified hospice care. Routine home care, general inpatient care, continuous home care, respite. Official Medicare site.

Learn About Medicare's Types of Healthcare ProvidersLearn about healthcare provider types Medicare covers & see which care provider is best for you. Compare doctors, nursing homes, more. Official Medicare site.

Browse & Compare Local Healthcare Providers by TypeCompare healthcare providers near you & browse by healthcare specialty. General practitioners, neurologists, optometrists, more. Official Medicare site.
